description: Put two listed AI tools side by side: category, use case, stated pricing, platforms, features, data quality and last-verified dates, with the fields where they differ called out. Call this when the user is choosing between two specific tools ("X or Y?", "how does X compare to Y?"), often after recommend_tool. Pass "task" to also see which listing covers that job better. Every value is what the listing states; a missing value means not stated, not absent from the product.

a.description: The first tool. A tool's slug ("acme-notes-jd7abc12"), EveryAI page URL, website ("https://acme.ai") or exact name ("Acme Notes").

b.description: The second tool, given the same way.

task.description: Optional: the job the user wants done, to see which of the two fits it better.

name: compare_tools
title: Compare two AI tools
